BIDDERS MUST SUBMIT CORRESPONDIN G DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCES SUCH AS ORDER COPY & CORRESPONDING PROOF O F SUPPLY (INVOICE COPY/CRAC COPY/CHALLAN COPY/RECEIPT COPY ETC.). 2) FIRM SHOULD HAVE GEAR HOBBING MACHINE. DOCUMENT IN SUPPORT SHALL HAVE TO BE SUBMITTED DULY SELF ATTESTED. 3) AUTHORIZED DEALER/DISTRIBUTOR /CHANNEL PARTNER OF OEM SHOULD SUB MIT VALID BID SPECIFIC AUTHORIZATION FROM OEM, ALONG WITH BID. HOWEVE

R, GUARANTEE CERTIFICATE ISSUED BY THE OEM/MANUFACTURER SHALL BE SUB MITTED ALONG WITH THE SUPPLY. Special Terms and Conditions: 1. MATERIAL TEXT SHALL BE READ AS GEAR BOX ASSLY COMPLETE AS PER PT. 1 TO 34 & 3 6 TO 40 OF DRAWING PD/R-142782 R1. 2. ALL MATERIAL, NOTES, DIMENSIONS, TOLERANCES, NOTES AND HEAT TREATEMENT SHA LL BE STRICTLY AS PER DRAWING. ALL WELDS SHALL BE OF 4 MM FILLET WELDS, UNLESS OTHERWISE MENTIONED. 3. ALL MATING SURFACES (JOINTS&SEATS) SHALL BE LAP MACHINED. ALL BORES & HOLES SHALL BE MADE IN ONE SETTING. 4. CASING SHALL BE OIL LEAK PROOF AND SHALL BE PAINTED WITH OIL RESISTANT PAINTS ON INSIDE.FOR OUTSIDE TWO COATS OF READY MIXED BRUSHING, RED OXIDE ZINC CHROMATE PRIMER, AS PER IS: 2074/62 & TWO COATS OF LIG HT GREY PAINT. 5. ALL THE GEAR TEETH SHALL BE CUT BY GEAR HOBBING / GENERATING PROCESS. 6. GEAR BOX CASING SHALL BE FABRICATED IN STEEL DULY STRESS RELIEVED FOR RIGIDIT Y.PRECISION STANDARD IN ACCURACY,SURFACE FINISH & SILENT RUNNING SHALL BE ENSURED BY PROFILE GRINDING OF HELICAL GEARS.TECH.SPEC.IN ALL THE PART DRAWIN GS TO BE FOLLOWED. 7. ALL THE SIDE COVERS SHALL HAVE A GREASING HOLE OF SIZE 1/4 BSP, WITH PLUG. 8. ONE NO GEAR BOX WITH TYPE-I(PD/R-142782) CONFIGURATION AND ONE NO WITH TYPE -II (PD/R-142782) CONFIGURATION IS TO BE SUPPLIED. 9. ALL CASTINGS AND FORGINGS SHALL BE ULTRASONICALLY TESTED AND COMPLY LEVEL 2 OF EN 10228-3 OR EQUIVALENT IN ASTM A388/A388M STANDARD. Inspection Terms: 1. INSPECTION AT RSP STORES AFTER RECEIPT OF MATERIAL. 2. CERTIFICATE FOR ULTRASONIC & HARDNESS TESTING ARE TO BE SUBMITTED BY THE FIR M FROM A GOVT APPROVED LAB DURING INSPECTION. 3. MATERIAL TEST CERTIFICATE SHALL BE SUBMITTED BY THE FIRM FROM A GOVT APPROVE D LAB. 4. GUARANTEE CERTIFICATE SHALL BE SUBMITTED BY THE FIRM. Guarantee Clause: GUARANTEE OF THE MATERIAL SHALL BE 12 MONTHS FROM THE DAT E OF INSTALLATION OR 18 MONTHS FROM THE DATE OF SUPPLY WHICHEVER IS EARLIER. Price Variation Clause: FIRM TILL DELIVERY. Delivery Requirements: DELIVERY IS REQUIRED WITHIN 6 MONTHS FROM DATE OF PO. Packing Clause: 1. SUITABLE PACKING SHALL BE PROVIDED TO AVOID DAMAGES DURING TRANSIT. CATALO GUE NO. & SUPPLIER EMBLEM SHALL BE CLEARLY EMBOSED ON ITEM.

RUST PREVENTIVE COATING SHALL BE PROVIDED PRIOR TO DESPATCH. 2. PACKING LIST TO BE SUBMITTED ALONG WITH SUPPLY OF MATERIAL. IDENTIFICATION OF MATERIAL W.R.T PACKING LIST SHALL BE ENSURED. SUPPLIERS EMBLEM, A/T NO, ITEM NO TO BE EMBOSSED/PUNCHED ON EACH ITEM . Place of Inspection: RSP STORES. Inspection Agency: MM, INSPECTION, SAIL, RSP, ROURKELA OR ITS AUTHORIZED REPRES ENTATIVE. BIDDERS TO NOTE: i. No technical deviation is acceptable. By submitting offer against this bid, the bidder is ac cepting all terms & conditions of the bid as well as GeM terms & conditions. ii. Bidders are requested to quote the price (inclusive of GST and all taxes/ duties) fo r all item(s) of the bid in GeM portal on F.O.R. Basis. iii. SAIL-RSP is entitled to claim credit of input tax (ITC) paid on the supply of the bid item (a s applicable). iv. Bidders are not required to upload signed copy of the bid again. Only relevant document (s) are to be uploaded for technical and commercial scrutiny. Submission of additional docu ments beyond the requirement will not be taken cognizance of. v. Bidders to compulsorily submit the duly-filled attached Annexure (ANNEXURE A & ANNEXURE B) on firm's letter head, with stamp and signature of authorized r epresentative, as part of online offer. Offers of bidders who do not submit the above d ocuments will not be considered further. vi. Any technical query/ clarification, is to be routed through the pre-bid representation fun ctionality available against this bid. vii. RPN clause - subject to the terms and conditions of the GeM contract, if the supplier neg lects or fails to perform the contract by the time or times agreed upon, for any reason othe r than force majeure, the purchaser after having come to know of such negligence or non-p erformance, after giving 15 days' notice to the seller to rectify or such any extended period that the seller and purchaser may mutually agree, shall take such action as it considers fit i ncluding but not limited to taking risk purchase action for supply of similar materials, mitig ating any losses, at the risk and cost of the supplier as far as the undelivered quantity in th at delivery period is concerned. The right of the purchaser for risk purchase action is in add ition to the right of purchaser to terminate the contract due to the fault of the supplier. The price differential in case of higher cost to SAIL-RSP, if any, shall have to be borne by the def aulting supplier. SAIL-RSP reserves the right to recover the price differential from pending b ills of the supplier in SAIL-RSP or other SAIL units. Moreover the defaulting supplier shall ha ve no claim over the quantity, which they failed to supply. viii. SAIL-RSP will be placing back-up order against GeM contract(s) on successful bidder(s). The concerned bidder has to mention the back-up order number in the invoices for proper a ccounting of material upon receipt in RSP. ix.
